title: Workflow capabilities
description: What the workflows can do for the repository, and who can set them going.

entities.name: Continuous delivery
entities.description: Every pull request is checked, and every change that reaches main is deployed to icelander.net, game by game.
entities.responsibility: Test and build each game a change touches, refuse database changes nobody has applied, and deploy each changed game from main.
access: Any pull request runs CI and the Database migration check; the workflows check nobody.
Deploying starts on a push to main, which takes only pull requests because main requires the Database migration check (AGENTS.md), or with Run workflow on deploy.yml.
Deploy jobs run in the production environment, which holds them for a reviewer if one is set in the repository's settings, and need the CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN secret.

relatedViews.relationship: Migrating a database is enforced by its gate.
The workflows and scripts that make it up.
